zh: 大纲工作台可围绕人物连续讨论，并保留对话与历版提案；勾选采纳后一起保存。
大纲目录支持手动添加卷、章、人物、伏笔和设定，也可搜索并在关联节点间跳转。
可与「大纲搭档」聊天起草或调整整份大纲；回复逐段显示，可展开思考过程并在采纳前核对提案。
人物联动提案中超出可改范围的建议只跳过无效项，其余修改仍可进入提案；提案格式偏差也会按内容识别。
en: Discuss a character continuously in the outline workbench, keep the conversation and prior proposals, and save only the edits you accept.
Manually add volumes, chapters, characters, foreshadowing, and settings in the outline directory, search by title, and jump between linked nodes.
Chat with the Outline Partner to draft or revise a full outline. Replies stream in, thinking can be expanded, and proposals are reviewed before save.
Out-of-scope character-impact suggestions are skipped without discarding the rest of the proposal; slightly off proposal formats are still recognized by content.
